display.title: Lane: Combat
display.subtitle: Fight your way up
description: The Combat lane is the boss-rush. Clear a share of EVERY boss in the
tier and you auto-advance - no tokens required.
T1 to T2: §c80%§r of T1 bosses
T2 to T3: §c90%§r of T2 bosses
T3 to T4: §c100%§r of T3 bosses (Lucifer is the final gate)
Boss and miniboss kills ALSO feed the combined token pool, so a fighter
who doesn't want the full clear can still bank their way up.
§7See the Combat group in this quest book.
